purpose: Targeted visual-reading additions; preserve the complete primary lesson and its order.

zh.title: 先分清楚：圖示機制，不等於事件證據
zh.introduction: 圖中的 Northstar 與小林是合成教學情境。圖例說明某種機制怎麼可能發生，不宣稱真實事件已發生。

items.label: 事實
items.text: 有資料直接支持的有限觀察；例如已收到簡訊。通話紀錄不等於通話內容。

items.label: 風險
items.text: 有可能受害而需要防護；例如回報曾交出驗證碼，應及時處理，但不代表已登入成功。

items.label: 假設
items.text: 待查證的解釋；例如簡訊與電話由同一方安排。圖中可為教學而設定，實案仍須證據。

items.label: 未知
items.text: 資料不足，暫不能下結論；例如未授權登入、資料外流或實際影響範圍。

en.title: A mechanism diagram is not incident evidence
en.introduction: Northstar and Lin are part of a synthetic teaching scenario. A diagram shows how a mechanism could operate; it does not establish that a real incident occurred.

items.label: Fact
items.text: A limited observation directly supported by evidence, such as receiving a text. A call record does not establish what was said.

items.label: Risk
items.text: Possible harm that warrants protection. Reported code disclosure needs timely action, but does not prove a successful login.

items.label: Hypothesis
items.text: An explanation to test, such as one party arranging the text and call. A diagram may stipulate it; a real case still needs evidence.

items.label: Unknown
items.text: Insufficient evidence for a conclusion, such as unauthorized login, exfiltration or the extent of impact.

zh.caption: 圖 1｜同一事件，四個觀察面向。
zh.concept: 分類是在描述同一事件，不是在四種攻擊裡選一種。
zh.visual: 以事件為共同參照，分別找目標、接觸管道、聲稱身分與要求行動；連線表達關聯，不是時間或因果。
zh.example: 小林是目標；簡訊與電話是管道；服務台是冒充身分；驗證碼是索取內容。
zh.technical: 同一組資料可以支持多個分類，但「特別針對」及「高價值目標」各需要相應證據。
zh.limits: 事實與假設要分開：被叫出姓名不自動證明量身設計；冒充主管也不自動等於 Whaling。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Four views of the same event.
en.concept: Classification describes one event; it does not require choosing only one attack label.
en.visual: Use the event as the shared reference for target, channel, claimed identity and requested action. Connections show relationships, not time or causation.
en.example: Lin is the target, text and voice are channels, the help desk is the claimed identity, and the code is what is requested.
en.technical: The same evidence can support several labels. Tailored targeting and a high-value target each require supporting evidence.
en.limits: Separate facts from hypotheses: knowing a name does not automatically establish tailoring; impersonating an executive does not by itself establish whaling.

zh.caption: 圖 2｜沿兩條訊息路徑，回頭追同一個控制來源。
zh.concept: 管道不同，不代表來源獨立。
zh.visual: 從小林沿簡訊與電話路徑往回看：兩條箭頭若都接到同一控制方，就沒有增加一份獨立身分證明。控制邊界不是電信網路邊界。
zh.example: 假客服能說出剛才簡訊的內容，可能只因為那則簡訊也是他安排的。
zh.technical: 箭頭表示誰安排或傳遞訊息，不表示來電者已通過身分驗證，也不表示攻擊者控制整個電話網路。
zh.limits: 圖中同源是合成情境的假設；真實案例若只有兩則一致訊息，同源與真實身分都仍待查證。

en.caption: Figure 2 | Trace both messages back to their controlling source.
en.concept: Different channels do not necessarily mean independent sources.
en.visual: Trace the SMS and voice paths backward from Lin. If both reach the same controller, they add no independent identity proof. This is a control boundary, not a telecom-network boundary.
en.example: The caller may know the earlier text simply because the same party arranged it.
en.technical: Arrows show who arranges or communicates a message, not verified identity or control of the entire phone network.
en.limits: Common control is a stipulated hypothesis in this synthetic scenario. Two matching messages alone leave their control and true sender unverified in a real case.

zh.caption: 圖 3｜真碼的傳送方向，與假客服的索取方向不同。
zh.concept: 驗證碼是真的，不代表索取它的人是真的。
zh.visual: 把三個角色固定看清楚：攻擊者先嘗試向平台發起請求；平台把碼送到小林手機；小林把碼交給冒充者；攻擊者再嘗試交回平台。箭頭要讀成「誰把什麼交給誰」。
zh.example: 小林沒有發起登入，卻在電話中念出平台剛送來的碼；風險出現在碼跨到不可信任一方的那一刻。
zh.technical: 平台仍會檢查有效性、操作對應與其他條件；末端是嘗試，不是成功保證。本例的簡訊碼依 NIST 分類屬帶外驗證。
zh.limits: 交出碼支持暴露風險；是否接受、誰登入、做過什麼仍屬未知，必須另查平台與操作紀錄。

en.caption: Figure 3 | The genuine-code path differs from the impostor’s request.
en.concept: A genuine code does not authenticate the person asking for it.
en.visual: Keep three roles distinct: the attacker attempts to initiate a platform request; the platform sends a code to Lin’s phone, Lin discloses it to the impostor, and the attacker attempts to submit it to the platform. Read each arrow as who sends what to whom.
en.example: Lin did not initiate a login but reads out a newly received code. Exposure risk arises when it crosses to an untrusted party.
en.technical: The platform still checks validity, the relevant operation and other conditions. The endpoint is an attempt, not guaranteed success. NIST classifies this SMS code as out-of-band authentication.
en.limits: Disclosure supports exposure risk. Acceptance, the login operator and subsequent actions remain unknown without platform and activity records.

zh.caption: 圖 4｜比較可轉交的碼與綁定驗證對象的證明。
zh.concept: 多一步驗證，與讓假網站無法利用驗證輸出，是兩件事。
zh.visual: 傳統碼的箭頭是可被人轉交的短期輸出；抗釣魚一側的箭頭是對指定服務的驗證證明，不是把私鑰交給服務或客服。
zh.example: 念出簡訊碼可能讓別人即時轉填；正確的 WebAuthn 驗證則把驗證對象納入機制。
zh.technical: 這不是一條魔法箭頭：瀏覽器先檢查網頁來源（origin）是否可使用該服務識別（RP ID）；驗證器依 RP ID 限定憑證。服務端另檢查回覆中 clientDataJSON 的來源與本次挑戰值（challenge）、驗證器資料的 rpIdHash，以及簽章等條件。[W3C WebAuthn：用戶端](https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-discover-from-external-source)；[服務端驗證](https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-verifying-assertion)
zh.limits: 驗證回覆不傳私鑰，不等於每把 passkey 永遠只存本機；可同步憑證能透過受保護的機制在裝置間同步。此圖也不能證明付款有授權，或復原、備援登入和裝置安全都已妥善處理。[NIST：可同步驗證器](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63b.html)

en.caption: Figure 4 | Compare a relayable code with verifier-bound proof.
en.concept: Adding a step and preventing an impostor site from exploiting an authentication output are different properties.
en.visual: The code-side arrow carries a short-lived output a person can relay. The resistant-side arrow represents proof for the intended service, not delivery of a private key to that service or a caller.
en.example: Reading an SMS code aloud may enable immediate relay; correctly implemented WebAuthn includes the intended verifier in its mechanism.
en.technical: This is not a magic arrow: the browser checks whether the calling origin may use the requested service identifier (RP ID); the authenticator scopes credentials by RP ID. The server separately checks the response’s clientDataJSON origin and current challenge, authenticator-data rpIdHash, signature and other conditions. [W3C: client](https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-discover-from-external-source); [server verification](https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-verifying-assertion)
en.limits: An authentication response does not transmit the private key; this does not mean every passkey remains on one device forever. Syncable credentials can use protected synchronization. The figure also cannot establish payment authority or sound recovery, fallback and device security. [NIST: syncable authenticators](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63b.html)

zh.caption: 圖 5｜真正的切換，是重新取得可信聯絡來源。
zh.concept: 查證要離開可疑方提供的來源，不只是換一個工具。
zh.visual: 路線 A 沿對方給的連結與號碼前進，仍留在同一控制範圍；路線 B 在暫停通話後，從先前已核實的入口另起查證。
zh.example: 自己開啟既有官方 App 與點進簡訊提供的「官方 App」連結，來源不同，不能當作同一條安全路徑。
zh.technical: 可信來源只建立可查證的起點；仍須分別核對身分、事件／要求與操作授權。路徑箭頭是查證步驟，不是可信程度自動增加。
zh.limits: 若入口也由可疑方臨時提供，邊界並未真正跨過。確認某人任職的事實，也不能推出他的所有要求都獲授權。

en.caption: Figure 5 | A real switch obtains contact details independently.
en.concept: Verification must leave the suspicious party’s source, not merely change tools.
en.visual: Path A follows that party’s links and numbers within the same control scope. Path B pauses the interaction, then starts a new check through a previously verified entry point.
en.example: Independently opening an existing official app differs from following an “official app” link in the suspicious text.
en.technical: A trusted source supplies a starting point for checks. Verify identity, the incident or request, and authority separately. Route arrows are checking steps, not automatic increases in trust.
en.limits: If the suspicious party supplies the new entry point, the boundary has not been crossed. Confirmed employment does not authorize every request.

zh.caption: 圖 6｜每個結論都有自己的證據門檻。
zh.concept: 事件判讀不是把五張卡片自動串成成功入侵故事。
zh.visual: 將每一項主張連到支持它的資料，並保留未確認狀態；接觸、暴露、登入、操作與外流不是必經的單一路線。
zh.example: 現在只有簡訊、通話紀錄與員工口述：接觸有資料，交碼有回報而構成風險；攻擊者成功登入及外流仍未確認。
zh.technical: 登入成功紀錄仍須核對操作者與授權；下載警示仍須核對資料、接收方和傳輸證據，不能跨級推論。
zh.limits: 可以先通報、保全與控制風險，但不能把處置需要寫成已證實損害；沒有查到紀錄也不等於證明安全。

en.caption: Figure 6 | Each conclusion has its own evidence threshold.
en.concept: Incident analysis does not automatically join five cards into a successful-compromise story.
en.visual: Link each claim to its supporting material and preserve unconfirmed states. Contact, exposure, login, actions and exfiltration are not one inevitable route.
en.example: With only a text, call records and an employee account, contact has evidence and reported disclosure creates risk. Attacker login and exfiltration remain unconfirmed.
en.technical: A successful-login record still needs operator and authorization checks. A download alert still needs data, recipient and transfer evidence before an exfiltration conclusion.
en.limits: Reporting, preservation and containment can precede certainty. The need to act is not proof of harm, and failing to find a log is not proof of safety.

zh.caption: 圖 7｜沿概念關聯找工具，不沿箭頭猜攻擊順序。
zh.concept: 知識地圖是選擇分析工具的索引，不是固定攻擊劇本。
zh.visual: 關聯線連結社交工程與偵察、行為分類、防禦、風險和應變；授權與 ROE 的外框約束整個測試及調查範圍。
zh.example: 收到假客服電話，可同時用 M09 看誘導、用 M01-05 描述行為，再用 M01-07 安排證據與處置，不必先證明經過每個模組。
zh.technical: ATT&CK 對應說明觀察到的行為類型；最小權限、驗證與應變則從不同位置降低風險，彼此不是必經前後步驟。
zh.limits: 模組有連線不代表攻擊成功，也不代表學習者已完成那些單元；教材示例不構成對真實帳號進行測試的授權。

en.caption: Figure 7 | Follow relationships to choose tools, not to infer attack order.
en.concept: A knowledge map indexes analytical tools; it is not a fixed attack script.
en.visual: Relationship lines connect social engineering with reconnaissance, behavior classification, defenses, risk and response. The authorization and ROE boundary governs the scope of testing and investigation.
en.example: For an impostor-support call, use M09 to examine persuasion, M01-05 to describe behavior and M01-07 to plan evidence collection and response without assuming every module occurred in sequence.
en.technical: ATT&CK mapping describes observed behavior. Least privilege, authentication and response reduce risk at different points, rather than forming mandatory consecutive stages.
en.limits: A connection proves neither attack success nor completion of a course unit. A teaching example does not authorize testing real accounts.

reasoningCheck.placement: After the existing checks, before the final lesson synthesis; do not replace the primary questions.

zh.title: 圖形推理檢核｜追來源、追流向、守住證據邊界
zh.scenario: 只使用這些已知資料：小林收到警告簡訊及跟進電話；平台送來登入碼；小林回報已把碼念給來電者。目前沒有平台登入、操作或傳輸紀錄。圖 2、3 是可能機制，不是調查已證實的全貌。
questions: 對照圖 2 與圖 5：若「查證電話」也是簡訊提供的，應留在哪個控制範圍？要改哪一段路徑，才能開始獨立查證？
對照圖 3：請指出真碼從誰到誰、交碼從誰到誰，以及最後一條只能標為「嘗試」的箭頭。為什麼不能把它直接改成「登入成功」？
對照圖 6：把目前可支持的事實、風險，以及仍是假設／未知的結論分開。若後來找到一筆成功登入，是否足以認定資料外流？還缺哪類證據？
zh.guidance: 先用箭頭、元件與證據說明理由，再展開參考解答。這是教學檢核，不會提交答案，也不記錄為已理解。

referenceAnswer.title: 參考解答｜圖形推理
parts: 1. 仍在可疑來源的控制範圍，換成電話不會產生獨立來源。切斷「簡訊提供聯絡方式 → 回撥查證」這條依賴，先結束互動，再自行開啟先前已核實的官方 App／服務台。之後仍要核對身分、要求與授權。兩則訊息同源是合理待查假設，不是僅憑一致內容即可定案。
2. 真碼：真正平台 → 小林手機；暴露：小林 → 冒充來電者；最後是攻擊者 → 真正平台的嘗試提交。圖示提出一種可能機制，但本題尚無提交或登入紀錄；有效性、操作對應、其他驗證條件與實際結果都不能由「交出碼」直接推出。
3. 可支持的事實包括已收到簡訊、發生通話、收到平台碼，以及存在員工交碼回報；僅憑通話紀錄不能證明說話內容。交碼回報形成暴露風險，應立即走正式通報與適當風險處置。共同行動者、攻擊者登入、未授權操作與外流仍需查證。一筆成功登入只支持登入事件，還須核對操作者、時間與授權；外流需進一步核實資料內容、接收方、傳輸與範圍。不要因缺日誌而推定安全，也不要因需處置而推定已外洩。

en.title: Visual reasoning check | Trace sources, transfers and evidence limits
en.scenario: Use only these known details: Lin receives an alert text and a follow-up call; the platform sends a login code; Lin reports reading it to the caller. No platform login, activity or transfer records are available. Figures 2 and 3 illustrate possible mechanisms, not a fully established investigation.
questions: Using Figures 2 and 5, where does a “verification number” supplied in the text belong? Which part of the route must change before an independent check can begin?
Using Figure 3, identify who sends the genuine code to whom, who discloses it to whom, and the final arrow that can only be labeled an attempt. Why can it not simply become “successful login”?
Using Figure 6, separate supported facts and risk from hypotheses or unknown outcomes. If a successful-login record is later found, does it establish exfiltration? What evidence is still missing?
en.guidance: Explain your reasoning using arrows, components and evidence before opening the reference answer. This teaching check does not submit a response or record confirmed understanding.

referenceAnswer.title: Reference answer | Visual reasoning
parts: 1. The number remains within the suspicious source’s control scope. Switching to voice does not create an independent source. Break the dependency from text-supplied contact details to callback verification: end the interaction, then independently open a previously verified official app or help desk. Still verify identity, the request and authority. Common control is a plausible hypothesis to investigate, not a conclusion established by matching content alone.

2. Genuine code: real platform → Lin’s phone. Disclosure: Lin → impostor caller. The final arrow is the attacker’s attempted submission → real platform. The diagram supplies a possible mechanism, but this scenario has no submission or login records. Code validity, the relevant operation, other authentication conditions and the actual result do not follow automatically from disclosure.

3. Supported facts include receipt of a text and platform code, the occurrence of a call, and the existence of an employee disclosure report. A call record alone does not establish the spoken content. The report creates exposure risk requiring official reporting and appropriate protective action. Common control, attacker login, unauthorized actions and exfiltration still need investigation. A successful-login record establishes a login event, but operator, timing and authority need checks. Exfiltration additionally requires verified content, recipient, transfer and scope evidence. Missing logs do not establish safety; a need to respond does not establish a breach.
